Kind.description: The kind of every element of items. Closed: a new kind comes with a new command result. Target is not a kind of its own; Status embeds it. AdvisoryList, SnapshotList and SignerList are one item that holds a list and the facts about it (the check, the chain, the current key).

set.description: Set name from repoctl.yaml. Absent for commands that run outside a set (version, schema).

setDir.description: Absolute path of the set directory.

command.description: The command path, e.g. "repo diff". Not the argument vector.

targets.description: Targets the command looked at, after --target filters.

Problem.description: One error or warning. code is the stable part; message is for people and may change in any release. A problem with humanAction is a step only a person may take ('needs human').

hint.description: One sentence: what to do next.

exitCode.description: The exit status this problem gives the command (cli-ref exit codes). Errors only.

ProblemCode.description: Open enum: a reader treats an unknown code as a generic error or warning. Codes are dotted: area.condition.

HumanAction.description: A step that repoctl, the MCP server or a skill must not take. The agent stops and asks the person.

command.description: The exact command the person can run.

ui.description: Path in the web UI, e.g. /s/slurm-26.05/publish.

Time.description: RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix, millisecond precision.

RunId.description: r- for a build run, p- for a publish run.

NodeState.description: waiting: not started (a dependency or a job slot is missing; there is no build queue). current and staged are plan states: they never occur as a state change in a run.

PlanAction.description: build: no build for this commit and target. current: the commit is in latest. staged: built for this lock and not published. skip: not selected, or the target is not in the package.

PlanReasonCode.description: Why a node has action build (03 section 3). A rebuild of a dependent is never a reason by itself: advisories say that a rebuild may be needed.

RunState.description: There is no queued state: repoctl has no build queue. abandoned: the process of the run died; a later command marked it.

FailureClass.description: host: the failure is in the host, not in the package: mock cannot start, no disk space, the mock group is missing. A retry can help after the host is fixed.

LockState.description: unpinned: the package is in repoctl.yaml and has no lock line. orphaned: the lock line has no package in repoctl.yaml (06 section 10).

CheckStatus.description: The three words of go-clikit doctor.Status.

snapshots.description: Per target: latest in the registry, the local copy, and the HTTP server.

open.description: Steps of new-set or onboarding that are not done yet.

mockConfigDigest.description: Hash of the resolved mock config (mock --debug-config). Not part of the build identity: a change needs build --force.

path.description: Directory of the target in the snapshot and below repo.url, e.g. el9.

url.description: repo.url for this target, as written in the .repo file of the release package.

versions.description: Per target id: the version and release rpmspec evaluates in that chroot.

upstream.description: The upstream block of repoctl.yaml, as written.

evr.description: Version-release from the SRPM header, e.g. 26.05.4-2.el9.

depth.description: Longest path from a root in this target's graph. Used for layered layout.

Graph.description: One target's graph. repoctl graph --json gives one item per target.

items.description: from must be built before to.

via.description: BuildRequires of to that a Provides of from matched.

unresolved.description: BuildRequires that no node of this target provides but a node of another target does. Not an error: base or EPEL repos may provide them.

dynamic.description: Nodes with %generate_buildrequires: their edges may be missing.

baseline.description: What the plan compared the commits with: the snapshot latest of each target, or none when the target has no snapshot yet.

advisories.description: Advisories that this plan raises (06 section 2). Required advisories block the publish of their closure.

dirs.description: Selectors given on the command line; empty is all.

from.description: Where package commits come from. worktree: the run is unpinned and never publishable.

failFast.description: Keep going is the default; failFast stops after the first failure.

reasons.description: Present and non-empty when action is build.

commit.description: The package commit that this node builds.

previousCommit.description: The commit in latest (action build) or the commit of the last staged build.

snapshot.description: action current: the publish id of the snapshot that holds the node, e.g. p-20260912-1403-c21.

fromRun.description: action staged: the build run that made the node.

from.description: Old value: the commit in latest.

to.description: New value: the commit of the node.

subject.description: commit-changed, rebuild: subject line of the new commit.

commits.description: commit-changed: number of commits between from and to.

text.description: rebuild: the reason that the person gave to repoctl rebuild (--reason).

StateCounts.description: Nodes per state. Every NodeState is a key, zero included.

client.description: MCP clientInfo.name, or the UI session id prefix.

publishable.description: Targets that repoctl publish accepts now: every node of the plan is current or staged for the lock; the set inputs are committed and pushed; no NVR is reused or removed.

next.description: Suggested next steps. Steps with human: true are for a person only.

publishBlockers.description: Why a target is not publishable (publish exit 12).

publish.description: publish runs only: per target result.

gate.description: Advisories that the check step looked at (06 section 4).

fromRuns.description: publish runs: the build runs whose staged nodes were published.

nvrs.description: NVRA of every binary RPM, debuginfo included, sorted.

node.description: logs/<run>/<node>.log: all output of all steps, with step markers.

mock.description: root.log, build.log, state.log, hw_info.log of the failing or last step, in logs/<run>/<node>/.

blockedBy.description: blocked: failed nodes upstream of this one.

repo.description: Repo name: slurm, slurm-source or slurm-debuginfo.

path.description: Absolute path in the staging repo of the run.

missing.description: builddep: the requires that could not be installed.

source.description: local: the local copy of latest. staging: the staging repo of a run. snapshot: a snapshot in the registry.

signature.description: Key id of the signature, or empty for unsigned staging RPMs.

snapshot.description: source snapshot: the publish id or digest.

changed.description: Same name and arch, other EVR.

rebuilt.description: Same NVRA, other payload digest. Publish refuses these (nvr.reused).

latest.description: Best upstream version, from github if set, else fedora.

newer.description: Tags between current and latest, oldest first.

cached.description: Answer came from the upstream cache (1 h).

changed.description: pin: the lock line was written by this call.

apiVersions.description: apiVersions this binary can write, e.g. ["repoctl/v1alpha1"].

Signer.description: Who signed. UIs show uid + fingerprint tail.

fingerprint.description: Full OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, upper-case hex, no spaces.

keyId.description: id of the key in sign.keys[] of repoctl.yaml.

backend.description: sign.backend of the user config, e.g. gpg.

deployed.description: keys/deployed.yaml has a record for the key.

human.description: true: only a person may take this step (publish). Agents show it and stop.

reason.description: kept: why, e.g. staged for next build, publishable, running.

name.description: e.g. cache, state, staging, git, local copy, runtime.

conflict.description: A set skill has the name of a builtin skill; set skills may add, never shadow.

Digest.description: An OCI digest: sha256: and 64 hex digits. Used for snapshots (manifest digest) and advisory facts.

subject.description: DIR@TARGET, DIR, or a source package name.

closure.description: Dirs whose publish this advisory blocks. Level required only.

stale.description: The facts changed after the dismissal; the advisory is open again.

Snapshot.description: One OCI manifest: all files of one set and target (05 section 6).

removed.description: Entries in removed[] of the manifest.

accepted.description: Advisory ids that the person accepted for this publish.

rpms.description: Per target: RPMs in latest that this key signed.

next.description: The command that the person runs next.
